{{Top|leg}}
The '''Storm Guard''' were an organization on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] charged with monitoring the weather around the floating city. Based out of [[Kerros Tower|Kerros' Tower]], they had authority to immediately shut down all [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] transport around the [[City/Legends|city]].
